This page presents the visual record of the closed-loop exploration: learned connectivity matrices, neural activity traces, connectivity scatter plots, kinographs, and learned signaling functions for each block. Each block introduces a new simulation regime; within each block, the LLM proposes training parameter mutations via UCB tree search with 4 parallel slots per batch.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Current status

**Block 30 completed** (1000 neurons, 100k frames). 360 iterations completed across 30 regimes. Frame count rescues dense and low-gain networks (300 neurons, 600 neurons, g=3 / 200 neurons at 30k; 1000 neurons at 100k --- 100% convergence, connectivity=1.000). Three structural limits confirmed: subcritical rho (sparse), connectivity ceiling at filling_factor (fill<100%), and g=1 fixed-point collapse. ~99 principles established.
:::

---

## Block 14 --- Recurrent Training Test (200 neurons, iters 157--168)

Recurrent training (time_step=4) at 200 neurons with supercritical rho=1.064. 8/12 iterations had infrastructure failures; 4 completed in batch 3 (iters 165--168). Recurrent boosts connectivity +0.3% but dynamics -12.3%. Warmup (start_ep=1) partially recovers dynamics. noise_rec=0.05 too high (partial).

## Block 22 --- Partial Connectivity fill=80% (100 neurons, 10k, iters 253--264)

Filling factor reduced from 100% to 80%. Activity rank=36 (same as 100% fill), rho=0.985 (near-critical, NOT subcritical). Connectivity plateau at exactly 0.802 with COMPLETE parameter insensitivity across all training params. 0/12 degenerate. Sharp transition from 50% fill: rho jumps 0.746→0.985. Connectivity ceiling approximately equals filling_factor.

::: {.block-hero}

![](log/Claude_exploration/instruction_signal_landscape_parallel/connectivity_matrix/block_022.png){.lightbox group="b22"}
